contentText: ttorney General Pam Bondi said Saturday that Venezuela’s leader Nicolás Maduro has been charged with drug trafficking and “will soon face the full wrath of American justice on American soil in American courts.” The announcement came after President Donald Trump said the U.S. carried out “a large-scale strike” in Venezuela and had captured and flown the pair out of the country. France24 International Affairs Editor Kethevane Gorjestani tells us more.
